name: abaco-observability
description: Phase 0 telemetry for ABACO DEEP HARNES' 3-layer context system: a host-plane row that observes compaction, pruning, spills and context pressure on the engine's own events and projections, and appends one JSON line per observation to <DSH_HOME>/logs/abaco-context.jsonl. It registers no service, adds no tool and never writes a session event.
